decks.notes: The main concept of this Doomsday Combo deck is to quickly assemble the cards needed to execute the Doomsday win condition, which involves stacking the perfect pile of cards to win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck focuses on fast mana acceleration, card draw, and control elements like counter spells to protect the combo. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Psychic Frog provide additional card advantage and control, while Street Wraith can be used to cycle through the deck. The deck aims to efficiently and effectively win the game as quickly as possible.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and planeswalkers. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Counterspell, Force of Will, and Prismatic Ending while drawing cards and gaining card advantage with Brainstorm and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The deck also aims to lock down the opponent's mana base with cards like Back to Basics and Counterbalance, while leveraging powerful planeswalkers like Teferi, Time Raveler and Narset, Parter of Veils to further control the game.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and staying ahead of the curve by utilizing cards like Magus of the Moon to disrupt opponents' mana bases, while incorporating aggressive creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer and Broadside Bombardiers to apply pressure. The inclusion of cards such as Fury and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker help maintain tempo and control the board. The deck also utilizes fast mana acceleration with cards like Simian Spirit Guide, Chrome Mox, and Lotus Petal to quickly deploy threats. Overall, the strategy revolves around quickly overwhelming opponents and maintaining control of the game.

This deck focuses on tutoring and ramping up quickly to play powerful creatures like Nadu, Winged Wisdom and Craterhoof Behemoth. It utilizes cards like Natural Order, Chord of Calling, and Green Sun's Zenith to search for key pieces. It also includes support cards like Allosaurus Shepherd and Collector Ouphe to protect the combo and disrupt opponents. The mana base is built around Gaea's Cradle to generate a lot of mana quickly, allowing for explosive plays. The deck aims to assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with a big board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through utilizing powerful mana generation from cards like Gaea's Cradle and mana dorks like Noble Hierarch and Ignoble Hierarch. It also aims to manipulate the board with creatures like Wight of the Reliquary and Springheart Nantuko, while utilizing cards like Natural Order and Green Sun's Zenith to search for key creatures like Craterhoof Behemoth for a finishing blow. The inclusion of cards like Endurance and Allosaurus Shepherd provide protection and disruption to the opponent's game plan. Overall, the deck aims for efficient mana ramp, control, and powerful creature plays.

The goal of this deck is to quickly assemble the Dark Depths combo by using cards like Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, and Elvish Reclaimer to find and assemble Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage. This allows the player to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token, putting immense pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Swords to Plowshares and Endurance to protect the combo and control the board. The deck's mana base is carefully constructed to support the combo while also providing utility lands for protection and advantage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Brainstorm, then reanimate them using cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Force of Will, Daze, and Stifle to protect the combo and control the game. The mana base is designed to support the casting of spells while also disrupting the opponent's mana base with cards like Wasteland.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy through countering spells, removing threats, and controlling the tempo of the game. It utilizes powerful control cards like Force of Will, Swords to Plowshares, and Supreme Verdict to maintain board presence and protect key threats like Narset, Parter of Veils and Teferi, Time Raveler. The deck also incorporates card draw and manipulation with Brainstorm, Ponder, and Day's Undoing to help find the necessary answers to deal with various threats. Additionally, the inclusion of Hullbreacher and Lórien Revealed helps generate advantage and further disrupt the opponent's game plan.

The main focus of this deck is to establish control over the game by utilizing powerful control spells such as Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Endurance and Wrath of the Skies while setting up card advantage with Brainstorm and Ponder. Additionally, the deck includes powerful threats like Uro, Titan of Nature's Wrath and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to close out the game. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure smooth mana development and consistency in casting spells.

The deck utilizes the Dark Depths combo to quickly create a 20/20 Marit Lage token by removing ice counters with Thespian's Stage or Vampire Hexmage. The deck also includes a variety of land tutors such as Crop Rotation, Knight of the Reliquary, and Elvish Reclaimer to assemble the combo pieces efficiently. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive creatures like Gaddock Teeg and removal spells like Swords to Plowshares to control the board and protect the combo. The deck aims to win quickly and efficiently through the Dark Depths combo while disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main concept of this Dimir Tempo deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan while efficiently deploying evasive threats that can quickly close out the game. Cards like Thoughtseize and Daze ensure that the opponent's key cards are dealt with, while Yuriko, the Tiger's Shadow and Changeling Outcast provide consistent damage and card advantage. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Ingenious Infiltrator help with card selection and filtering, while cards like Fatal Push and Murderous Cut deal with opposing threats. The goal is to stay ahead on board and in hand to secure a victory through efficient aggression.

The key concept of this deck is to use Doomsday as a combo piece with Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck focuses on finding and casting Doomsday to set up a winning pile of cards that will allow the player to win the game on the spot. The deck includes disruption and card filtering spells such as Brainstorm, Daze, and Ponder to help the player find the necessary pieces for their combo. Additionally, the deck includes ways to protect the combo with cards like Force of Will and Fatal Push.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on quickly casting powerful Eldrazi creatures and disrupting the opponent's strategy with Chalice of the Void. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker while utilizing cards like Devourer of Destiny and Sowing Mycospawn for additional value. With a mix of ramp and disruption, this deck can quickly build a board presence and control the game through its powerful Eldrazi creatures.

The main theme of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building a strong board presence through efficient creatures and removal spells. By utilizing cards like Swords to Plowshares and Chain of Smog to control the opponent's board, combined with powerful creatures like Knight of the Reliquary and Questing Beast, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. Additionally, the deck includes a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for with Green Sun's Zenith, allowing for flexibility in dealing with various threats.

The main concept of this deck is to generate mana quickly using creatures like Noble Hierarch and Birds of Paradise, then combo off with cards like Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to draw through your deck and find a game-ending Craterhoof Behemoth or other finisher. The deck also utilizes cards like Allosaurus Shepherd and Sylvan Safekeeper to protect your combo pieces and disrupt your opponent. With a mix of creature tutors like Chord of Calling and Green Sun's Zenith, along with powerful removal options like Natural Order, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its explosive combos and efficient threats.

The main idea of this deck is to use cards like Show and Tell, Sneak Attack, and Omniscience to cheat big creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn onto the battlefield early and overwhelm the opponent with their powerful abilities. The deck also includes cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to support the combo strategy. The deck is designed to quickly assemble its key pieces and execute its game plan efficiently, making it a strong and aggressive combo deck in the Legacy format.
